# bb diff

Print the diff of a pull request, a commit or two refs

3 commands.

[`bb diff commit`](#bb-diff-commit)
:   Diff a commit against its parent

[`bb diff pr`](#bb-diff-pr)
:   Diff a pull request

[`bb diff refs`](#bb-diff-refs)
:   Diff two refs or commits

## `bb diff commit`

Diff a commit against its parent

```text
bb diff commit <commit> [flags]
```

```bash
# What one commit changed
bb diff commit a1b2c3d --repo PROJ/repo

# In one file
bb diff commit a1b2c3d --repo PROJ/repo --path src/main.go
```

`--path string`
:   Optional file path for file-scoped diff

Inherited from [`bb diff`](#bb-diff):

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug (defaults to BITBUCKET\_PROJECT\_KEY + BITBUCKET\_REPO\_SLUG)

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Runs as usual: this command changes nothing, so there is nothing to hold back

<details class="note" data-search-exclude>
<summary>Output with <code>--json</code>, where <code>?</code> marks a field that can be absent</summary>
<pre><code>data
  repository    object
    projectKey  string                Project key the repository belongs to.
    slug        string                Repository slug.
  output        patch|stat|name-only  Which form was produced: patch, stat or name-only.
  patch?        string                The unified diff, when output is patch.
  names?        list of string        Paths that differ, when output is name-only.
  stats?        map of any            Per-file addition and deletion counts, when output is stat.
</code></pre>
</details>

## `bb diff pr`

Diff a pull request

```text
bb diff pr <pr-id> [flags]
```

Also available as bb pr diff, which is the gh spelling.

```bash
# The diff of a pull request
bb diff pr 42 --repo PROJ/repo

# Only the names of the files it changes
bb diff pr 42 --repo PROJ/repo --name-only

# As a patch, saved to a file
bb diff pr 42 --repo PROJ/repo --patch > pr-42.patch
```

`--name-only`
:   Output only changed file names

`--patch`
:   Output unified patch stream

`--stat`
:   Output structured diff stats

Inherited from [`bb diff`](#bb-diff):

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug (defaults to BITBUCKET\_PROJECT\_KEY + BITBUCKET\_REPO\_SLUG)

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Runs as usual: this command changes nothing, so there is nothing to hold back

## `bb diff refs`

Diff two refs or commits

```text
bb diff refs <from> <to> [flags]
```

```bash
# What feature/x changes relative to main
bb diff refs main feature/x --repo PROJ/repo

# As added and removed line counts per file
bb diff refs main feature/x --repo PROJ/repo --stat
```

`--name-only`
:   Output only changed file names

`--patch`
:   Output unified patch stream

`--path string`
:   Optional file path for file-scoped diff

`--stat`
:   Output structured diff stats

Inherited from [`bb diff`](#bb-diff):

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug (defaults to BITBUCKET\_PROJECT\_KEY + BITBUCKET\_REPO\_SLUG)
